title: Introduction to Device Features
overview: Expo provides APIs that allow applications to interact with hardware features available on mobile devices.

title: Device Information API
overview: Expo Device API provides information about the physical device such as model, operating system, and device type.

title: Battery Information
overview: Battery APIs allow applications to access battery level and charging status information.

example.content:

title: Haptics and Vibration
overview: Expo Haptics provides vibration feedback to improve user interaction experiences.

title: Screen Orientation
overview: Expo Screen Orientation API allows applications to control and detect device screen orientation changes.

title: Network Information
overview: Network APIs help applications detect internet connectivity and network status.

example.title: Network Flow
example.content:

title: Biometric Authentication
overview: Expo Local Authentication allows applications to use device security features like fingerprint and face recognition.

example.title: Biometric Flow
example.content:
User Request
 ↓
Fingerprint / Face Scan
 ↓
Authentication Result

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Expo accesses device information, battery, haptics, orientation, network, and biometric features.
